name: ifc-b2zr
definitions:
inductive {Exp} where
  | {lit} (n : Nat)
  | {var} (x : Nat)
  | {op0} (a b : {Exp})
  | {op1} (a b : {Exp})

inductive {Com} where
  | {cskip}
  | {cassign} (x : Nat) (e : {Exp})
  | {cseq} (c d : {Com})
  | {cite} (e : {Exp}) (c d : {Com})

abbrev {St} := Nat → Nat
abbrev {Ctx} := Nat → Bool   -- true = secret, false = public

def {upd} (s : {St}) (x v : Nat) : {St} := fun y => if y = x then v else s y

def {evalE} (s : {St}) : {Exp} → Nat
  | .{lit} n => n
  | .{var} x => s x
  | .{op0} a b => ({evalE} s a) + ({evalE} s b)
  | .{op1} a b => ({evalE} s a) * ({evalE} s b)

def {lvl} (G : {Ctx}) : {Exp} → Bool
  | .{lit} _ => false
  | .{var} x => G x
  | .{op0} a b => {lvl} G a || {lvl} G b
  | .{op1} a b => {lvl} G a || {lvl} G b

def {evalC} (s : {St}) : {Com} → {St}
  | .{cskip}       => s
  | .{cassign} x e => {upd} s x ({evalE} s e)
  | .{cseq} c d    => {evalC} ({evalC} s d) c
  | .{cite} e c d  => if {evalE} s e = 0 then {evalC} s d else {evalC} s c

def {wt} (G : {Ctx}) (pc : Bool) : {Com} → Bool
  | .{cskip}       => true
  | .{cassign} x e => !({lvl} G e || pc) || G x
  | .{cseq} c d    => {wt} G pc c && {wt} G pc d
  | .{cite} e c d  => {wt} G (pc || {lvl} G e) c && {wt} G (pc || {lvl} G e) d

def {lowEq} (G : {Ctx}) (s t : {St}) : Prop := ∀ x, G x = false → s x = t x

rungs.proof: intro x hx; exact (h x hx).symm

rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (s t u : {St}) (h1 : {lowEq} G s t) (h2 : {lowEq} G t u)
rungs.proof: intro x hx; exact (h1 x hx).trans (h2 x hx)

rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (s t : {St}) (x v : Nat) (h : {lowEq} G s t)
rungs.statement: {lowEq} G ({upd} s x v) ({upd} t x v)
rungs.proof:
intro y hy
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  · simp [{upd}, hyx]
  · simp [{upd}, hyx]; exact h y hy

rungs.role: public expressions evaluate alike in agreeing states
rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (s t : {St}) (e : {Exp}) (hl : {lvl} G e = false) (h : {lowEq} G s t)
rungs.proof:
induction e with
  | {lit} n => rfl
  | {var} x => exact h x (by simpa [{lvl}] using hl)
  | {op0} a b iha ihb =>
    simp [{lvl}, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hl
    simp [{evalE}, iha hl.1, ihb hl.2]
  | {op1} a b iha ihb =>
    simp [{lvl}, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hl
    simp [{evalE}, iha hl.1, ihb hl.2]

rungs.role: a secret-context assignment cannot touch a public variable
rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (s : {St}) (x : Nat) (e : {Exp}) (hw : {wt} G true (.{cassign} x e) = true)
rungs.statement: {lowEq} G s ({upd} s x ({evalE} s e))
rungs.proof:
simp [{wt}] at hw
  intro y hy
  have : y ≠ x := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hy; rw [hw] at hy; exact Bool.noConfusion hy
  simp [{upd}, this]

rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (e : {Exp}) (c d : {Com}) (s : {St}) (hc : {lowEq} G s ({evalC} s c)) (hd : {lowEq} G s ({evalC} s d))
rungs.statement: {lowEq} G s ({evalC} s (.{cite} e c d))
rungs.proof:
by_cases hz : {evalE} s e = 0
  · simp [{evalC}, hz]; exact hd
  · simp [{evalC}, hz]; exact hc

rungs.role: secret-context code leaves the public projection fixed
rungs.statement: ∀ (s : {St}), {wt} G true c = true → {lowEq} G s ({evalC} s c)
rungs.proof:
induction c with
  | {cskip} => intro s _; exact {lowEq_refl} G s
  | {cassign} x e => intro s hw; exact {assign_conf} G s x e hw
  | {cseq} c d ihc ihd =>
    intro s hw
    simp [{wt}, Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
    exact {lowEq_trans} G _ _ _ (ihd s hw.2) (ihc ({evalC} s d) hw.1)
  | {cite} e c d ihc ihd =>
    intro s hw
    simp [{wt}, Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
    exact {conf_ite} G e c d s (ihc s hw.1) (ihd s hw.2)

rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (s t : {St}) (x : Nat) (e : {Exp}) (hw : {wt} G false (.{cassign} x e) = true) (h : {lowEq} G s t)
rungs.statement: {lowEq} G ({evalC} s (.{cassign} x e)) ({evalC} t (.{cassign} x e))
rungs.proof:
intro y hy
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  · subst hyx
    have hlv : {lvl} G e = false := by
      simp [{wt}, hy] at hw; exact hw
    simp [{evalC}, {upd}, {evalE_agree} G s t e hlv h]
  · simp [{evalC}, {upd}, hyx]; exact h y hy

rungs.binders: (G : {Ctx}) (e : {Exp}) (c d : {Com}) (s t : {St}) (hc : {wt} G true c = true) (hd : {wt} G true d = true) (h : {lowEq} G s t)
rungs.statement: {lowEq} G ({evalC} s (.{cite} e c d)) ({evalC} t (.{cite} e c d))
rungs.proof:
have cs := {conf_ite} G e c d s ({confinement} G c s hc) ({confinement} G d s hd)
  have ct := {conf_ite} G e c d t ({confinement} G c t hc) ({confinement} G d t hd)
  exact {lowEq_trans} G _ _ _ ({lowEq_trans} G _ _ _ ({lowEq_symm} G _ _ cs) h) ct

rungs.role: well-typed programs leak nothing from secret to public
rungs.statement: ∀ (s t : {St}), {wt} G false c = true → {lowEq} G s t → {lowEq} G ({evalC} s c) ({evalC} t c)
rungs.proof:
induction c with
  | {cskip} => intro s t _ h; exact h
  | {cassign} x e => intro s t hw h; exact {assign_ni} G s t x e hw h
  | {cseq} c d ihc ihd =>
    intro s t hw h
    simp [{wt}, Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
    exact ihc _ _ hw.1 (ihd _ _ hw.2 h)
  | {cite} e c d ihc ihd =>
    intro s t hw h
    simp [{wt}, Bool.and_eq_true] at hw
    by_cases hlv : {lvl} G e = false
    · have hg := {evalE_agree} G s t e hlv h
      simp [hlv] at hw
      by_cases hz : {evalE} s e = 0
      · simp [{evalC}, hz, ← hg]; exact ihd _ _ hw.2 h
      · simp [{evalC}, hz, ← hg]; exact ihc _ _ hw.1 h
    · have hlvT : {lvl} G e = true := by
        cases hl : {lvl} G e with
        | false => exact absurd hl hlv
        | true => rfl
      simp [hlvT] at hw
      exact {ite_high_ni} G e c d s t hw.1 hw.2 h
